title: Tracker call sites ignore the repo's [issues] restrictions: daemon issue endpoints, `issue list`, `kaneo`
description:
Follow-up from THE-695 (landed 2026-10-01, main @ d96c73fbb).

A repo's `.thegn.toml` `[issues]` is an `IssuesOverlay` (`crates/thegn-core/src/config_issues.rs:329`) that can only NARROW: `providers`, `accounts` (by name), and pins like `[issues.linear] team_id`. `Config::repo_issues(Some(root))` (`config.rs` ~:6881) applies it. (It cannot ADD accounts or tokens — pinned by `repo_overlay_cannot_inject_tracker_accounts`.)

THE-695 switched `wt new --from-issue` and the daemon's `worktrees.create` to `repo_issues`. These still use the GLOBAL `cfg.issues`:
- `crates/thegn-host/src/daemon/service.rs` ~:1733 `issues_list`, and `issues_get` / `issues_update` / `issues_comment` (~:1776, :1791, :1805) — control-API requests carry no repo context today.
- `crates/thegn-host/src/cmd/issue.rs` ~:146 — CLI verb; a cwd repo is available.
- `crates/thegn-host/src/cmd/kaneo.rs` ~:113 — CLI verb; a cwd repo is available.
- `crates/thegn-host/src/hydrate.rs` ~:3805 — check whether it should be repo-scoped.
(Already correct: `autopilot_driver.rs`, `hydrate_tracker.rs`, `hydrate.rs` ~:4393, `handlers/tracker.rs` use `from_config_at`.)

Consequence: in a repo that pins accounts or a team, `issue list` and the control API act across ALL accounts/teams. Not a credential leak, but it defeats the scoping.

## Acceptance criteria
- `thegn issue list` and `thegn kaneo …` inside a repo honour its `[issues]` restrictions and pins; outside a repo, unchanged.
- Control-API issue endpoints can be scoped to a repo, defaulting to today's behaviour when unscoped.
- Tests for a repo that restricts accounts and pins a team, on each surface.
